item: terminal panel: run the app with the browser closed (R600, R601)
summary: The launcher window now shows a small clickable terminal panel while the app runs: lock state, network and collection, server memory and CPU, and every running job with its progress, with Open UI, Pause collection, Show log, Stop app (second press) and Close panel. You can close the browser and leave the app collecting; reopen the UI from the panel. Loopback only; it never asks for the passphrase and never goes online (resume stays in the browser's consent window). Closing the window or Ctrl-C still stops the app. OO_PANEL=0 turns it off. Windows: opens in its own window when windows-curses is installed (not yet run on Windows).
